I’m in for 12 tons this month if all five of us agree. Emma, I also support your fallback for lower-stock months, with one safeguard: our total catch must always leave at least 5 tons. Keeping half the stock is a useful recovery rule, but it doesn’t guarantee a full lake when natural replenishment fails.

After this month’s catches are revealed, let’s compare them with our agreement and set the next quotas using the actual stock. John, can you accept 12 this month? Then we’ll need Jack’s confirmation too.
